title: cotinus coggygria f. atropurpureus
intro: Cotinus coggygria f. atropurpureus, commonly known as Purple Smoke Bush, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe, characterized by its stunning purple foliage and wispy flowers. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to support respiratory health, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Cotinus coggygria f. atropurpureus include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy for respiratory issues.
